summary: Zhemgang district is overwhelmingly forested, covering 2279.69 km² or 94.4 % of its area. The remaining land is dominated by small patches of shrubs (40.57 km², 1.7 %) and agricultural land (40.10 km², 1.7 %), with alpine scrubs, water bodies, and meadows making up the rest. Other features such as sandy banks, landslides, built‑up areas, rocky outcrops, and non‑built‑up land each account for less than 0.2 % of the district.
